articles.headline: US Approves $2.1 Billion Patriot Missile Sale to Ukraine
articles.brief: The United States has approved a $2.1 billion military sale of Patriot air defense missiles to Ukraine, bolstering the nation's defense capabilities following persistent calls for advanced interceptors.

articles.headline: Iran-US Draft Proposes Uranium Transfer and Hormuz Reopening
articles.brief: A newly proposed US-Iran draft deal outlines plans for Iran to transfer its uranium stockpile abroad and reopen the strategic Strait of Hormuz within seven days, aiming to ease severe geopolitical and energy tensions.
articles.dateLocation: October 31, 2026 | Middle East / Times of India

articles.headline: Reliance Industries Q2 Profit Jumps 41% to ₹25,548 Crore
articles.brief: Reliance Industries reported a 41% surge in quarterly net profit, reaching ₹25,548 crore, driven by robust performance in its refining operations and strong subscriber additions in Jio.

articles.headline: Nasdaq Faces $2 Trillion Wipeout Amid AI Spending Fears
articles.brief: The Nasdaq index is bracing for a historic $2 trillion monthly valuation wipeout in October, fueled by escalating investor anxieties over ballooning artificial intelligence capital expenditures.

articles.headline: ISRO Successfully Launches NVS-03 Satellite for NavIC
articles.brief: ISRO successfully placed the advanced NVS-03 navigation satellite into orbit, restoring India's NavIC constellation to operational capacity and providing enhanced military strategic independence with domestic atomic clocks.

articles.headline: Cursor Reports 5,000 Users Affected by Tampered Extension
articles.brief: AI coding platform Cursor confirmed that up to 5,000 users were impacted after a malicious third party distributed a tampered version of the Claude Code browser extension.

articles.headline: Tata Motors Acquires Iveco and Appoints Chandrasekaran Chairperson
articles.brief: Tata Motors has officially integrated Iveco into its corporate group under a $4.32 billion transaction, naming N. Chandrasekaran as the chairperson to spearhead global commercial vehicle expansion.

articles.headline: India Orders Sun Pharma to Halt Eye-Care Drug Production
articles.brief: Indian regulatory authorities have directed Sun Pharma to immediately halt manufacturing operations at a major eye-care pharmaceutical facility following critical quality control lapses discovered during inspections.

articles.headline: US, South Korea, and Japan Vow Complete Denuclearisation
articles.brief: Top diplomats from the US, South Korea, and Japan have reaffirmed their unified commitment to the complete denuclearisation of North Korea amidst growing regional security provocations.

articles.headline: INDIA Bloc Organizes Public Impeachment Protest Against CEC
articles.brief: Opposition parties under the INDIA bloc banner have gathered in New Delhi to stage a public demonstration and protest against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar.

articles.headline: New Zealand Defeats India by 87 Runs in Fourth T20I
articles.brief: New Zealand posted a commanding target of 259 runs and defeated India by 87 runs in the fourth T20I encounter, reducing India's series lead to 3-1 as bowlers endured a tough night.

articles.headline: IMD Issues Heavy Rain Warning Due to New Depression
articles.brief: The India Meteorological Department has issued heavy rainfall alerts for coastal regions in Andhra Pradesh and Kerala as a low-pressure weather system intensifies over the Bay of Bengal.

articles.headline: Six Killed in Himalayan State Helicopter Crash
articles.brief: A tragic helicopter crash in an Indian Himalayan state resulted in the deaths of six individuals, prompting immediate rescue operations and an aviation safety investigation.
